'''SK-21 support droids''' were [[Droid/Legends|droids]] produced on the planet [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] by the rogue [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] [[HK-47]] to support his droid army. Their design was based on that of HK-47. Several of them were destroyed in the crater of a [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]] by a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] that fought against HK-47 and his droids.

==Behind the scenes==
The SK-21 support droids' first and only appearance was in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|''Trials of Obi-Wan'']], the third expansion for [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. It appeared during the final stage of the [[:w:c:swg:Champion of Mustafar|Champion of Mustafar]] quest line that takes place in the crater of a volcano and pits a group of players against HK-47 and his droids.

It is unclear whether these droids were designed by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] on Mustafar based on HK-47's body they found in the wreckage of a [[Unidentified Hammerhead-class cruiser|crashed ''Hammerhead''-class cruiser]] or by HK-47 himself after he gained control of the Separatists' old droid factory.
